messages:
Maya L.: quick pulse: EdgeCloud integrator launch — final gating items before marketplace publish. Need owners for: embargo owner, landing hero + 2 CTA variants, demo script for SI, localized microcopy (FR/DE), and post-launch metric dashboard. Target window: Tue Jul 22.

Ethan B.: I can own embargo + comms cadence. Partner prefers Tue 23:59 PT; legal needs signoff by Mon 12:00 PT. If legal misses, fallback = delay 24h.

Sofia G.: taking landing hero + CTAs and localized copy. Draft hero tonight: "Run Redwood inference alongside EdgeClouds managed stack". CTAs: `Try in your cloud` / `Contact sales`. Will add FR/DE variants.

Maya L.: nice. SI demo script owner? Need reproducible steps and sample dataset that SI can run in 20m.

Ethan B.: @Sofia G. any chance you can add a shorter dev-friendly CTA for US docs? maybe `Quickstart`?

Sofia G.: yes adding `Quickstart` for dev docs. Locale note: FR CTA = `Essayer dans votre cloud`, DE CTA = `Im Cloud testen`.

ops-bot: Staging tenant provisioned: rwd-edgecloud-stg-0722. Creds emailed to Ethan B., Sofia G. Expires in 72h.

Maya L.: demo script sketch:

```
# SI demo script (20m)
1) Verify tenant + API key
2) Run inference: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rw-accelerate","input":"Summarize product update"}' https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate
3) Run embeddings search against sample dataset
4) Show latency table and cost estimates
```

Ethan B.: perfect. I'll make a short slide with embargo timing, embargo contact list (press + partner comms), and escalation path.

Sofia G.: screenshot checklist: hero shot, latency graph (5 runs avg), and transcript snippet. Will avoid customer PII and blur any real ids.

Maya L.: legal ask: partner legal must sign off on joint blog and quote by Mon 12:00 PT. @Ethan B., can you confirm you have partner legal contact?

Ethan B.: confirmed. looping them into the dry run invite.

Maya L.: dry run options: Mon 17:00 PT or Tue 07:00 PT. Mon 17:00 gives buffer for fixes — leaning that.

ops-bot: Calendar invite: EdgeCloud integrator dry run scheduled for 2024-07-21T00:00:00Z (Mon 17:00 PT) — invite sent.

Sofia G.: localization note: will upload localized CTAs + alt-hero lines to the drive and mark required legal review fields.

Ethan B.: fallback publish plan documented: if legal misses Mon noon -> push publish to Wed 23:59 PT and notify sales + comms.

Maya L.: owners recap -> Embargo & comms: Ethan B.; Landing + localization: Sofia G.; Demo script + runbook: Maya L.; Staging infra: ops-bot. If anyone needs to swap, please shout now.

Sofia G.: all good from me. I'll drop copy and screenshots by EOD. :memo:

Ethan B.: will draft the partner-facing embargo email and share for review.

Maya L.: thanks team — see you at dry run. :rocket:
